name: Mg Candidate 1
cover_gas: SF6/CO2 (0.5-1% SF6) or protective flux (e.g. RJ-1) -- MANDATORY
flux: RJ-1 or KCl-MgCl2 flux for refining; skim before pouring
safety: NEVER melt Mg without SF6/CO2 cover gas or flux -- molten Mg BURNS in air.
Keep dry sand / class-D extinguisher at hand; NEVER use water on an Mg fire.
Preheat all tools, moulds and charge to >150 C to avoid moisture (explosion risk).
Work in a fume hood / well-ventilated area -- MgO fume and SF6 decomposition products.
No rust or iron oxide in contact with the melt (thermite-type reaction).
notes: Family detected: mg_li -> heat treatment T4/anneal (Mg-Li).
Grain refinement / texture control matters more for Mg than for Al (HCP has few slip systems): consider Zr (Mg-Zn-Zr) or Ca (weak texture).
Mg-RE alloys form Mg-RE intermetallics at grain boundaries -> creep resistance.
Mg-Li is the lightest structural metal (rho ~1.35-1.6); Li is volatile -- expect loss, and handle Li dry (reacts with moisture).
